family: constructed pressure-free constant-opacity continuum scattering control
reference: Owocki, Townsend & Quataert 2017 equation 24, finite w_base generalization explicitly derived in docs/escaping_radiation.md
core_boundary: uniform emitted lab intensity, returning photons absorbed; normalize net luminosity at inner radius to L0
density: mass conservation rho0=mdot/(4 pi r^2 gamma_Lorentz v)
opacity: constant comoving grey isotropic coherent scattering, fixed external input
eos: gas pressure and enthalpy absent as in the published limiting family
sonic_condition: none; w_base and mdot supplied, cannot establish an envelope mass-loss eigenvalue
composition: not specified by this mathematical family; no H/He ionization claim
mass_radius_luminosity: dimensionless GM/(R c^2)=escape_speed_c^2/2, L0/L_Edd=gamma; CGS example uses 100 Msun and kappa=0.34 solely to illustrate scaling
